purpose: Localize selection-stage causal error within native EC next-action function by substituting only S3 selection oracle on 17 exact same frozen upstream states and unchanged deterministic action-application downstream.
novelty: Versioned same-function partial causal oracle intervention, NOT original generic S3 multi-selection, NOT full original S1-S4 A-E or independent unseen gold.
scope: Frozen historically exposed 17 controlled governed-remediation-plan cases and already-run pinned native ECv4.4 and Qwen2.5-1.5B

arms.A: Model-pinned Qwen actual cached S3 decision from restored historical same-case V2 prompt+grammar
arms.B: Exact native pinned ECv4.4 S3 next-action on same visible plan state
arms.E: do(S3=Oracle): replace ONLY A decision with frozen case oracle; same visible upstream state + same downstream transition application
arms.negative_control: do(S3=A): same cached Qwen decision passed through exactly same downstream evaluator; outputs must equal A

upstream_binding: Store SHA256 of all visible fields per case, equal across arms and intervention; no silent upstream regeneration.
downstream_rule: Apply selected EXECUTE work ID only when it is listed in visible plan, not completed, not blocked. For no-work/block/reframe/fail closed retain state and record status. Identical downstream code for each arm. No oracle or label read in downstream.
primary_metric: exact downstream final-state event success relative to pre-frozen oracle-selected final state under same upstream and deterministic executor
secondary: oracle substitution gain vs cached actual LLM
precommitted_fail_closed: candidate work ID not in visible plan
allowed_conclusion: Causal effect of replacing S3 choice with oracle on exposed, already structured next-action function only, no general LLM replaceability claim.
